spec_match.rationale: Reads the exact page-observable surfaces of the HTTPS-by-default push (window.isSecureContext, location.protocol, Resource Timing nextHopProtocol) and explains the loopback trustworthy-origin rule that shapes Balanced mode's exemptions.

interactive.rationale: Re-read button re-runs the live probe with a host-specific explanation; the stylesheet button reads a real Resource Timing entry; the gate list runs real presence checks in this context.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature index promises live readouts of this page's own security state plus the localhost surprise; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers https, http-on-loopback (secure), and plaintext-public (insecure) verdict branches, missing Resource Timing entries, and the geolocation property-vs-call gating nuance.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5143933628841984, MDN Secure Contexts, and sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the same secure-context contracts the page probes (https implies secure, loopback trustworthy, public http not secure), with manual entries for the non-page-observable interstitial and policy.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3, autorun exercised both buttons; screenshots read; verdict green on http://localhost with nextHopProtocol http/1.1 evidence; zero console errors; only environmental fonts.googleapis TLS failure from the sandbox proxy.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on the context read, the Resource Timing probe (found and not-found branches), and the gate probe.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, button colour pairs overridden together, AA pairs (emerald/rose on stone, ivory on black).

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible focus, dl/dt/dd readouts, aria-live on verdict/explanation/gate list, real table with caption and th scope for the trustworthiness matrix.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth via CDP), auto-fit readout grid wraps, table wrapped in overflow-x scroll container, 44px buttons.

openQuestions.title: Verify the insecure-context branch on a real plaintext http host
openQuestions.detail: The local server and the https deployment both produce secure contexts, so the red 'NOT a secure context' verdict and the absent gated APIs were only exercised by code review, not runtime. Loading the page over http from a LAN IP (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:3000) would show the insecure branch for real and is worth one manual pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid repeat(auto-fit, minmax()) with gap for wrapping stat readouts; set min-inline-size:0 on items holding long unbreakable strings; never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Readout dl uses auto-fit minmax(150px,1fr) with gap; cells set min-inline-size:0 and overflow-wrap:anywhere on dt/dd; the origin table sits in an overflow-x:auto scroll wrapper instead of clipping.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use landmarks and sequential headings, native buttons, and aria-live text equivalents for visual state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: main landmark with h1→h2 order, native buttons, aria-live=polite on the verdict, explanation, and gate list so re-probes are announced; colour-coded verdicts also carry full text.

summary: Live probe concept for the page-observable half of Ask-before-HTTP. Verified via CDP headless Chromium 141 on both device classes with autorun interaction; the only unexercised branch is the genuinely-insecure context, recorded as an open question.
